title: Team
readOnly: Only admins and owners can invite people or change roles. You can see who is on the team.

invite.title: Invite to the team
invite.description: They get an email with a link that works once for 7 days.
invite.name: Name
invite.nameHint: Shown to the team. They can change it later.

pending.title: Pending invitations
pending.resent: A new invitation was sent to {{email}}.
pending.revokeDescription: The link in their email stops working. You can invite them again later.

edit.title: Edit {{name}}
edit.description: Changes apply the next time they open a page.
edit.customRoleHint: Limits or extends what this staff member can do. Create roles on the Roles page.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.description: They lose access at once and are signed out everywhere. Their past work stays in the history.
remove.reasonHint: Kept in the audit log, for example: left the company.

errors.forbidden_role: Your role can't grant or change that role.
errors.last_owner: The organization needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
errors.permission_denied: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.invalid_input: Check the details. The person may already be on the team or invited.
errors.rate_limited: Too many invitations. Try again later.
errors.send_failed: The email could not be sent, so no invitation was created. Try again.
errors.not_found: That person is no longer on the team.

help.owner: Everything, including billing and other owners.
help.manager: Runs the day: pauses queues, sees reports and switches in other staff.
help.frontdesk: Calls, serves and adds guests at their locations.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.adminHint: Also edits locations, hours, screens and the team (except owners).

lines.title: Lines and privacy
lines.toggle: Limit staff to their own lines
lines.offHint: Off: front desk staff see and serve every line at their locations, including each guest's answers.
lines.onHint: On: staff you assign to specific lines see only those lines' guests and answers. Staff set to all lines, managers, admins and owners still see everything.
lines.pickerHint: Applies while "Limit staff to their own lines" is on. Pick at least one line, or all lines for front desk.
